summary: This Form 6-K filed by Baiya International Group Inc. on June 1, 2026, reports that Ms. Siyu Yang resigned as CEO and Chairman, effective immediately, with no disagreement cited. Ms. Linxi Xie was elected by the remaining board to fill both roles. Ms. Xie, a Partner at Antelope Holdings with over ten years of experience in overseas IPOs and cross-border capital markets, assumes leadership. No material terms, consideration, or advisor are involved. The departure is abrupt but not tied to any operational dispute, suggesting a strategic change in direction. The filing is a standard non-US equivalent of an 8-K for a management change. Watch for any further strategic announcements or operational shifts under new management.
